keyword: how to become an AI developer after 10th
title: How to Become an AI Developer After 10th (2026)
desc: Become an AI developer after Class 10: Python, AI APIs, RAG, agents and cloud AI services, with a year-by-year plan, projects, certificates and salary.
h1: How to become an AI developer after 10th
lead: A plan for a Class 10 student and their parent to read together. It shows how a real 624-hour, three-year curriculum leads to building apps that use AI, with a six-month option for younger students.
role_intro: An AI developer builds apps and tools that use AI models made by others. A typical task is connecting a language model through an API, giving it your own documents with RAG, or letting an agent call tools. The focus is the software around the model, not inventing new models.

day_to_day.answer: An AI developer spends the day writing application code around ready-made AI models: calling them through APIs, feeding them the right documents, giving agents tools to use, and fixing what breaks for users.
day_to_day.html:
Typical tasks: adding a feature that sends a request to a language model and shows the reply. Setting up retrieval (RAG) so answers come from the right files. Letting an agent call functions such as a search. They handle slow or failed responses, store results, and write tests that check the answers. They work with designers, back-end developers and product owners.

Main tools: Python, Git and GitHub, cloud AI services on Azure and AWS, and Docker and Linux to run the app.

How it differs from an AI engineer: an AI developer treats the model as a service to call and focuses on the app and the user. An AI engineer is also responsible for the model side: choosing it, adapting it, measuring it and monitoring it. In small teams, one person often does both.

first_project.answer: A realistic first project is a notes helper: a Python program that finds the right passage in your own school notes for any question, which is the retrieval half of a RAG app.
first_project.html:
Spend two or three weeks building it from the command line.

  • Week 1: save 10 to 15 pages of your own notes as text files. Write Python that splits them into short chunks.
  • Week 2: write a search function that returns the three chunks sharing the most words with a question. Show the file name so you can check the source.
  • Week 3: write 15 questions with known answers and record which ones the tool finds. If you can use an AI model API, send the question with those chunks and ask for a short answer. If not, the search-only version is still a complete project.

In the program, this grows into the Document RAG assistant in year 3: an assistant that answers from your own files.

in_short: An AI developer writes the app, not the model. The work is code that connects ready-made models to users, files and tools.
You can try it before Class 10 ends. AI Foundation, open from Class 9, has a 9-hour module on Python AI APIs, agents and automation.
Coding habits count most. Small working apps on GitHub that use AI APIs, RAG and agents show more than marks.
start_answer: Yes, you can start after Class 10, or from Class 9 with AI Foundation, because an AI developer first needs everyday coding skill and a feel for how apps talk to AI models.
start_bridge: Because AI development is mostly coding, your stream choice affects degrees more than skills. Here is the honest picture for each.
streams: B.Tech in computer science through JEE Main, plus BCA and B.Sc. Keeps both AI development and ML engineering open.
Little free time in Class 11 and 12. Keep a small weekly slot for building.
Commerce or Humanities with Computer Science
BCA and many computer application degrees. AI app building rewards finished projects over stream.
Without Physics and Mathematics in Class 12, B.Tech through JEE Main is not possible.
Practical computing from day one, which suits app builders.
Rules for moving into a degree later differ by state. Check them early.
start_extra: Students in Class 9 can take the six-month, 104-hour AI Foundation course, which ends with a deployed AI app. From Class 11, AI/ML Engineering goes much deeper.
roadmap_answer: Across three years, year 1 builds Python, data skills and your first Azure AI solution, year 2 builds APIs, transformers and AWS AI services, and year 3 builds RAG apps, agents, multimodal tools and cloud AI products.
year_focus: Year 1: write solid Python and call your first cloud AI services
Year 2: build AI services and APIs, and learn how language models work
Year 3: ship RAG apps, agents and multimodal tools on the cloud
fit_note: This curriculum is Python and AI focused. It does not teach native Android or iOS app development, so a mobile front end for your AI app would be extra self-study.
skills_answer: An AI developer needs strong Python, Git, working with APIs, prompt and context design, embeddings and RAG, agent and tool design, cloud AI services on Azure and AWS, testing of AI output, and responsible AI habits.

certs_answer: Microsoft AI-901 suits AI developers best because over half of it is about building with Microsoft Foundry, and IBM AI Engineering adds RAG and LangChain, though each certificate is awarded only by its own body.

cert_notes.Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-901): Weighted 40–45% on AI concepts and 55–60% on implementing AI solutions with Microsoft Foundry. Microsoft says some Python syntax knowledge is needed.
cert_notes.IBM AI Engineering Professional Certific: Includes a course on AI agents using RAG and LangChain, and a final project building generative AI applications with RAG and LangChain.

cert_extra: AI-901 preparation is also part of the final module of AI Foundation, so a younger student can prepare for it within six months.
notfor_answer: AI development is not for you if you dislike coding, want to research new models rather than use them, or expect a guaranteed job once you can call an AI API.
notfor: No honest program promises a job, salary or exam pass. This one does not.
Most of the work is ordinary software: APIs, data, errors and tests.
You want to invent new models.

salary_answer: Indicative India ranges for AI/ML roles, including GenAI developer and AI solutions developer, are about ₹5 to 10 lakh a year for freshers, ₹12 to 25 lakh at 3 to 5 years, and ₹30 to 60 lakh or more for senior roles.
faqs: How many years does it take to become an AI developer after 10th?

Plan for about three years of steady learning, such as the 3-year, 624-hour AI/ML Engineering program. Many employers also ask for a degree, so most students build these skills alongside Class 11, 12 and college.
Can I become an AI developer without maths?
You need less maths than an ML engineer, because you build on existing models. Logic and basic statistics still help. Keeping maths in Class 11 and 12 keeps the B.Tech route through JEE Main open.
What is the difference between an AI developer and an AI engineer?
An AI developer mainly builds apps on top of AI APIs and models. An AI engineer often also trains, evaluates and runs models and designs larger AI systems. Titles vary by company.

Yes. AI Foundation is a six-month, 104-hour course at 4 hours a week, open from Class 9 with no coding needed. It covers Python, prompt and context engineering, RAG, AI APIs and agents, and a deployed AI app.
Which programming language should an AI developer learn first?
Python. Both AI Foundation and AI/ML Engineering use it from the start, because most AI APIs and libraries are built for it.
context_fact: Nasscom's Strategic Review 2026 says AI has moved from optional to core infrastructure across India's tech industry. More companies now need developers who can put AI inside everyday software.
